premise_assessment:
The core premise — that intrinsic properties carry capability signal beyond raw scale — is plausible, partially supported, and presented with unusual statistical honesty (partial correlations, LOFO, OOB bootstrap with a gain CI spanning zero). But as currently constructed the headline claim is vulnerable on five fronts.

(1) CIRCULARITY — the feature matrix contains disguised behavioral measures. scripts/analyze_correlations.py excludes only `benchmark_*`, `composite_benchmark`, and `n_params` from X; everything else is a "feature". The univariate top-25 (docs/TOP_PREDICTORS.md §1) is dominated by likelihood/confidence measures: geometry_perplexity.{ppl_freq −0.89, ppl_overall, mean_nll_nats, bits_per_char}, interpretability_prediction_entropy.{median_entropy, mean_top5_prob, mean_top1_prob}, and THREE independent copies of corpus cross-entropy loss emitted as side-products (causality_ablation.baseline_loss, causality_attention_knockout.baseline_loss, dynamics_sharpness.baseline_loss). WikiText NLL is the training objective; observational-scaling work (Ruan et al., cited in §2) already shows loss predicts benchmarks, so "perplexity predicts MMLU" is not a contribution and a reviewer will say the suite smuggles the answer into the question. The v2 LASSO selection avoids raw perplexity but still includes logit_lens.entropy.min (intermediate-layer decoded confidence) and the v3 selection includes causality_ablation.loss_ablate_25pct/degradation_25pct and consistency_icl_slope.icl_relative_gain (few-shot accuracy — literally a mini-benchmark). Roughly 17–20 of the 72 tasks are output/likelihood/accuracy-derived: geometry_perplexity, geometry_prediction_alignment (cosine-to-correct-unembedding ≈ normalized logit), geometry_representation_sensitivity (closed-form ||W_y − Σp_k W_k||² — a confidence functional), interpretability_prediction_entropy, interpretability_logit_lens (acc/entropy), consistency_{calibration, icl_slope, format_robustness, paraphrase, logical, contrastive, self_consistency, knowledge_capacity, position_sensitivity, contamination, membership_inference}, dynamics_generation_diversity, causality_ablation loss heads, induction_heads accuracy components. TASK_FIXES.md itself proposes reclassifying calibration and prediction_entropy as Y-variables only — the paper has not yet absorbed its own audit's conclusion. The genuinely intrinsic core is real and substantial — weight spectra (spectral, weight_norms, hubness, unembedding), activation geometry (svd/isoscore, collapse, matrix_entropy, schatten, lid, intrinsic_dim, correlation_dimension, cka/hsic/rsa, lipschitz, neural_collapse, contextualization, mahalanobis), attention structure (entropy, rank, graph, sinks, positional_decay), topology, RepE directions, gradient/intervention probes (sharpness, gradient_flow, tracing, knockout, knowledge_neurons) — but the paper never separates its contribution from the near-behavioral block. The single most important missing experiment is a LASSO restricted to strictly intrinsic features.

(2) SCALE LEAKAGE THROUGH CONFIG ECHOES. The v3 LASSO's selected features include geometry_cka.n_layers (raw model depth — an architecture spec, not a representational property) and geometry_unembedding.unembedding_is_tied (a config flag); the top-|β| v3 feature is geometry_tokenizer_efficiency.vocab_utilization. The univariate table includes geometry_intrinsic_dim.sample_size (#14, ρ=+0.83) — a token-count artifact. "Beyond log N_params" controls for one parameterization of scale while depth, width, vocab size, and tokenizer fertility remain in X as alternative scale axes. The honest baseline is a multivariate spec-sheet model (log N + depth + width + vocab size + release date + training tokens where public), not univariate log N.

(3) DATA-RECENCY CONFOUND ON THE v3 HEADLINE. The strongest new claim — baseline LOO R² collapses 0.43→0.06 while intrinsic features hold at 0.78 — is genuinely interesting but confounded: same-size old-vs-new pairs differ chiefly in training-data volume/quality and tokenizer generation. The paper's own limitation #6 concedes tokenizer/word-tracking features proxy training-data volume, and the top v3 coefficient is a tokenizer feature. A release-date-only baseline (or log N + generation index) might recover much of the v3 gain; without that comparison, "intrinsic geometry beats scale" and "newer models are better and intrinsic features can smell newness" are indistinguishable.

(4) POWER AND EVALUATION PROTOCOL. n=32: the OOB bootstrap gain CI is [−0.30, +1.03] — the paper says at α=0.05 it cannot reject zero gain, yet the abstract leads with LOO R²=0.78 uncaveated. LOO is additionally optimistic because held-out models keep family siblings in training (Pythia-12B predicted with Pythia-6.9B in-fold); LOFO (0.27 v2 / 0.50 v3) is the honest number and should be the headline. No bootstrap CI exists for the v3 numbers (results/study_v3/analysis/ has no bootstrap output). The 49,708-test FDR machinery is fine for screening but the "top-25" tables are post-selection and need stability-selection or split-half validation. The min-max composite Y is zoo-dependent (adding v3 models changes every model's Y), so v2 and v3 composites are not the same variable.

(5) MEASUREMENT VALIDITY DEBT. Fifteen tasks are flagged in TASK_FIXES.md as redesign/reclassification candidates and two HIGH design flaws remain open (#11 edge_attribution off-manifold corruption, #19 position_sensitivity with no lost-in-the-middle headroom); topology H1 features — which the audit deems numerical noise at 20 points — are nonetheless LASSO-selected in BOTH v2 (betti_1_curve.q75, num_loops_h1.slope) and v3. Noise features being selected is itself evidence the selection is partly fitting idiosyncrasy.

TIER TAXONOMY: principled in conception (data dependency is the right axis) but post-hoc in execution. The paper (§3.1) defines Tier 3 as "interventional or backward passes" while RESEARCH.md/Section E define it as "behavioral probes requiring controlled design" — two incompatible definitions; under the paper's definition the consistency battery is Tier 2, under the repo's it is Tier 3. The appendix template even says "Tier: 1 or 2" with no Tier 3 option, and no per-task tier assignment appears anywhere in the paper. geometry_tokenizer_efficiency is labeled Tier 1 ("weight-only") despite touching no weights. The tier axis also fails to encode the distinction that actually matters for the premise — whether a measurement is a legitimate X (intrinsic predictor), a Y in disguise (behavioral), or a confound covariate (tokenizer/config).
taxonomy_critique:
The 7-category scheme is a provenance taxonomy (which literature each task came from) masquerading as a measurement taxonomy, and it leaks. Concrete misfilings: (1) geometry_perplexity — perplexity/NLL/BPC is a pure output-likelihood measure filed under "geometry"; RESEARCH.md §5 simultaneously lists it as a secondary Y-variable while analyze_correlations.py uses it as an X feature — it is in both the predictor and target conceptual sets. (2) geometry_prediction_alignment is registered in src/blme/tasks/geometry/consistency.py — a file literally named consistency.py inside the geometry package — and measures a normalized-logit/behavioral quantity, not geometry. (3) geometry_representation_sensitivity lives in geometry/information_geometry.py (task name ≠ file name) and is a closed-form functional of the predictive distribution — closer to a confidence/robustness measure. (4) geometry_tokenizer_efficiency is tokenizer-only (no weights, no activations) yet sits in geometry as "Tier 1 weight-only"; it is explicitly framed in the appendix as a confound covariate, which is a third role the taxonomy has no slot for. (5) geometry_mahalanobis is an OOD-detection diagnostic, not representation geometry per se. (6) interpretability_attention_rank (attention_rank.py, Dong 2021) vs interpretability_attention_effective_rank (attention_polysemanticity.py) — two near-identical registered names measuring near-identical quantities in differently-named files; reviewers and users will conflate them. (7) geometry_hsic lives in mutual_info.py; geometry_svd and geometry_isoscore share isotropy.py — file/registry naming is inconsistent across the package. (8) "Dynamics" is described in the README as "temporal behavior" but contains no temporal measurements: sharpness is loss-landscape curvature (optimization geometry), interpolation is latent-space smoothness (geometry), generation_diversity is output behavior (consistency-like), coe is an across-LAYER trajectory (depth, not time). Nothing in the suite measures training-time dynamics. (9) "Consistency" mixes four distinct things: output invariance (paraphrase/format/contrastive/self-consistency), calibration (a Y-variable), data-integrity forensics (contamination, membership inference), and capability probes (knowledge_capacity, icl_slope). (10) causality_ablation is acknowledged in TOP_PREDICTORS as a "BLME diagnostic" — random-dimension ablation degradation is a robustness measure, not causal analysis.

Better organizing axes (use both, as a two-way table): AXIS A — measurement substrate, which also induces tier mechanically: weights-only / tokenizer-only / forward activations / attention maps / gradients / interventions (patching, ablation) / output likelihoods / generated text. AXIS B — epistemic role in the study: intrinsic predictor (X), behavioral target or quasi-target (Y-like, excluded from headline X), confound covariate (tokenizer, config echoes, partialled out but never counted as a discovery). The current categories can be kept as a readers' guide, but the analysis sections must operate on Axis B, and the appendix needs a complete 72-row table giving task → category → substrate → tier → role. Counts also drift across documents and must be reconciled: 72 (paper, README, registry — verified 72 registered names), 71 (RELATED_WORK.md Appendix B), 54 ("intrinsic tasks" in RELATED_WORK §2.2/§2.10), ~62 run end-to-end, 731 vs 734 vs ~920 candidate features (paper vs RESEARCH.md vs findings_report.md "26 of ~920").
redundancy_clusters: Spectrum-flatness / effective-rank family (largest cluster, ~8 tasks): geometry_svd (Roy–Vetterli erank, participation ratio, cosine anisotropy), geometry_isoscore (IsoScore), geometry_collapse (per-layer erank, collapse_ratio, EDG), geometry_matrix_entropy (von Neumann entropy = log-form of erank), geometry_schatten (Schatten-p, MNN, RankMe — RankMe IS exp(H(σ̂)), the same erank with a different σ normalization), geometry_spectral.stable_rank + geometry_weight_norms.stable_rank (weights), geometry_unembedding.effective_rank (weights), interpretability_activation_sinks.compression_valley (computed FROM the matrix-entropy trajectory). All are monotone functionals of one singular-value distribution per layer; #35 even unified them on a shared effective_rank helper. EDG, collapse_ratio, erank.q75, RankMe, MNN, and Diff-eRank-style matrix entropy are siblings, not independent predictors.

Dimension-estimator family: geometry_lid (Levina–Bickel MLE), geometry_intrinsic_dim (Facco Two-NN), geometry_correlation_dimension (Grassberger–Procaccia), geometry_hubness (kNN-graph skew — a function of the same neighbor structure). All four estimate dimensionality from nearest-neighbor distance ratios on the same point cloud; Two-NN is the k=2 limit of the same likelihood underlying LID.

Topology family is internally one measurement: topology_homology, topology_betti_curve, topology_persistence_entropy, topology_persistence_landscape all re-summarize a single Vietoris–Rips diagram built from ~20 mean-pooled sentence vectors; H0 statistics are determined by the pairwise-distance MST (i.e., nearest-neighbor distances again, overlapping the dimension-estimator cluster), and H1 at n=20 is audit-acknowledged numerical noise (Section B item f) yet is LASSO-selected in both v2 and v3.

Layer-similarity / depth-trajectory family: geometry_cka, geometry_hsic (linear CKA is exactly normalized HSIC — the paper's own appendix says so), geometry_rsa, geometry_lipschitz (adjacent-layer change magnitude), dynamics_coe (across-layer magnitude/angle trajectory), plus interpretability_logit_lens trajectory features. Five-plus tasks summarize how much adjacent layers transform the representation.

Attention-concentration family: interpretability_attention_entropy, interpretability_attention_rank, interpretability_attention_effective_rank (near-duplicate of the previous), interpretability_attention_graph (Gini, bos_sink_ratio), interpretability_activation_sinks (Sinkε, bos_attn_fraction), geometry_positional_decay. Six tasks summarize concentration/locality of the same cached attention maps; bos_sink_ratio and Sinkε and bos_attn_fraction are three implementations of the same sink phenomenon.

Corpus-likelihood / confidence family (the circularity cluster): geometry_perplexity (ppl/NLL/BPC), interpretability_prediction_entropy (entropy, top-1/top-5 prob), causality_ablation.baseline_loss, causality_attention_knockout.baseline_loss, dynamics_sharpness.baseline_loss (three verbatim copies of corpus CE), consistency_calibration (ECE/Brier are functionals of confidence+accuracy), geometry_prediction_alignment (normalized logit), geometry_representation_sensitivity (closed-form confidence functional), interpretability_logit_lens.acc/entropy at the final layers. All monotone in next-token predictive quality on WikiText.

Massive-activation / outlier family: interpretability_activation_sinks.massive_activation_* (Sun 2024), interpretability_sparsity.layer_kurtosis (kurtosis is inflated by the same outlier coordinates), interpretability_superposition utilization. The LASSO selecting sparsity.layer_kurtosis.q25/q50 alongside activation-sink features is double-counting one phenomenon.

Linear-direction / RepE family: repe_task_vectors (cosine diversity), repe_concept_separability, repe_refusal_direction (direction_norm, projection_gap), repe_steering_effectiveness, and interpretability_probing — all measure linear decodability/separability of concept directions in the same hidden states.

Scale/config/tokenizer echo family: geometry_tokenizer_efficiency.{vocab_size, fertility, compression_ratio, total_tokens}, geometry_intrinsic_dim.sample_size, geometry_contextualization.n_words_tracked, geometry_cka.n_layers, geometry_unembedding.unembedding_is_tied — not representational measurements at all; they are spec-sheet/data-volume proxies and should be covariates, not discoveries. TOP_PREDICTORS positions 6 and 13–16 are this single confound appearing five times.

Cross-cutting consequence the paper must state: with 8 aggregator summaries per per-layer profile on top of these clusters, the '731 features' are perhaps 30–60 effectively independent measurements (the paper's own PCA — 49.5% of variance in 3 PCs — is direct evidence). The claim in §Implications that the top-6 partial predictors 'are not redundant sensors of a single underlying signal' is asserted without a feature-feature correlation analysis and should be backed by one.
gaps: (1, highest value) Training-dynamics validation via Pythia intermediate checkpoints. Pythia ships ~154 revisions per size; running the Tier-1/Tier-2 suite over training time would convert the study's weakest point (correlation across models) into within-model longitudinal evidence — does erank/alpha/LID move BEFORE benchmark gains? Cheap, uses existing infrastructure, and directly answers the causation objection. Currently nothing in the suite touches training time despite a category named 'dynamics'.

(2) A tokenizer-free / byte-level or multilingual evaluation corpus. The tokenizer confound is the paper's own acknowledged Achilles heel (limitation 6; top v3 LASSO coefficient is a tokenizer feature). Recomputing the activation-geometry suite on byte-normalized text (and one non-English corpus) would show which geometric signals survive when tokenizer maturity is held out — a far stronger answer than listing the confound.

(3) Random-matrix-theory activation spectra. The suite has HT-SR alpha on WEIGHTS but no RMT diagnostics on ACTIVATION covariance: Marchenko–Pastur bulk deviation, fraction of outlier eigenvalues, eigenvalue-spacing statistics. These are distinct from the erank family (which only summarizes flatness, not bulk-vs-spike structure) and connect to the massive-activation thread already in the suite.

(4) Across-position trajectory geometry. dynamics_coe measures across-LAYER trajectories; nothing measures across-TOKEN trajectory structure within a sequence — curvature/straightening of representation trajectories (Hosseini & Fedorenko-style), residual-stream norm growth with position, loss-vs-position slope. This is a genuinely missing geometric family and also a cheap long-context health signal.

(5) Information-theoretic compression estimates. The IB framing (EDG, §4) is operationalized only via effective rank. Actual compression measures — prequential/description-length estimates on the eval corpus, area-under-the-loss-curve as a compression proxy, mutual-information estimates between layers beyond linear-kernel HSIC — would ground the bottleneck story in information theory rather than linear algebra.

(6) Uncertainty geometry / Fisher structure. geometry_representation_sensitivity computes only a mean gradient norm; the Fisher information spectrum at the LM head (or a low-rank NTK/Fisher sketch) would characterize how confidence is geometrically organized, distinct from the scalar confidence measures that currently dominate the behavioral cluster.

(7) Weight-graph modularity/clusterability. No metric measures modular structure of MLP/attention weights (graph clustering coefficients, block structure) — a Tier-1 family that is fully intrinsic, corpus-free, and orthogonal to spectra.

(8) Perturbation-robustness of representations (weight noise / quantization sensitivity). dynamics_stability perturbs inputs; sensitivity of hidden states or loss to small weight perturbation (effective precision) is a distinct intrinsic property linked to flatness but measured forward-only, and is practically relevant (quantizability correlates with training quality).
recommendations: P0 — Run the decisive ablation: re-fit the LASSO on a strictly-intrinsic feature subset, excluding all likelihood/accuracy/confidence-derived columns (geometry_perplexity.*, interpretability_prediction_entropy.*, all three *.baseline_loss copies, logit_lens.acc/entropy, calibration, icl_slope, format_robustness/paraphrase/logical/contrastive NLLs, knowledge_capacity, generation_diversity, prediction_alignment, representation_sensitivity) and all config/tokenizer echoes (n_layers, vocab_size, sample_size, total_tokens, unembedding_is_tied). Report headline numbers for FULL vs INTRINSIC-ONLY vs BEHAVIORAL-ONLY feature sets. If the intrinsic-only gain survives, the paper's premise is dramatically strengthened; if not, the framing must change. This single table preempts the most damaging review.

P0 — Strengthen the baseline: replace univariate log N with a spec-sheet baseline (log N + depth + width + vocab size + release date/generation index + public training-token counts). The v3 'size baseline collapses to 0.06' claim is only meaningful against the strongest cheap alternative; a release-date term likely recovers much of it (data-recency confound), and the paper must show intrinsic features beat THAT.

P0 — Fix paper-vs-execution inconsistencies before any submission: §3.3 says 500 passages / 200 hidden-state samples / topology 50, but the executed study used 200 passages / num_samples=100 / topology 20 (RESEARCH.md §2); §3.2 and Table 2 say v3 is 'in progress'/'pending HF license' and 'headline numbers are all on the locked v2 zoo' while the abstract, §5.4, and conclusion report completed v3 results; Discussion line ~539 contains stale future tense ('Partial correlations will reveal...'); feature-count drift 731/734/~920 and task-count drift 72/71/54 across paper, RESEARCH.md, findings_report.md, RELATED_WORK.md; the paper cites results/study_v2/analysis/lasso_features.csv which does not exist in the repo (only v3's does); TOP_PREDICTORS.md defines the composite over '68 benchmarks' while the paper says 6.

P1 — Make LOFO the headline and caveat LOO: LOO keeps family siblings in training so 0.77/0.78 overstates generalization; lead with LOFO 0.27→0.50, present LOO as an upper bound, and add an OOB bootstrap CI for the v3 numbers (none exists in results/study_v3/analysis/).

P1 — Add an effective-dimensionality-of-the-feature-set section: cluster the 731 features (the nine redundancy clusters above are a starting point), report the number of effectively independent signals, and replace the unsupported claim that the top-6 partial predictors 'are not redundant sensors' with an actual feature-feature correlation/cluster analysis. Use stability selection or split-half replication for the top-25 tables to address post-selection optimism.

P1 — Quarantine audit-flagged features from headline analyses: topology H1 features (audit-acknowledged noise at 20 points) are LASSO-selected in both v2 and v3; #11 edge_attribution and #19 position_sensitivity features (open HIGH design flaws) and the 15 TASK_FIXES redesign/reclassification candidates should be excluded or explicitly flagged in every results table, with the exclusion list in the appendix.

P1 — Publish the per-task taxonomy table: 72 rows × {category, substrate, tier, X/Y/confound role}, with ONE consistent Tier-3 definition (the paper and RESEARCH.md currently contradict each other), and reconcile the appendix template that only offers 'Tier: 1 or 2'. Rename or merge interpretability_attention_rank vs interpretability_attention_effective_rank; move geometry_prediction_alignment out of geometry/consistency.py or rename the file.

P2 — Add the Pythia intermediate-checkpoint longitudinal analysis (gap #1): it is the cheapest credible response to the correlation-vs-causation limitation and turns the 'dynamics' category into something that actually measures dynamics.

P2 — Reframe EDG: the paper's own §5.7 shows EDG is dominated by collapse_ratio and erank.q75 from the same profile, and it sits inside a crowded lineage (RankMe, Diff-eRank, compression valley). Present it as a convenient summary statistic of the compression profile, not a headline novel-metric contribution, or strengthen it (e.g., show it adds incremental signal over its siblings in a nested model).

P2 — Fix the composite-Y construction: min-max normalization over the zoo makes Y depend on zoo membership, so v2 and v3 targets are different variables; switch to a fixed normalization (e.g., per-benchmark chance-to-ceiling rescaling) and report per-benchmark prediction results so the composite isn't doing hidden work.

P3 — Resolve remaining MEDIUM open items that touch reported features before camera-ready (positional_decay row-pooling bias, correlation_dimension point-count, contextualization occurrence counting), and decide explicitly whether tokenizer-efficiency features are confound covariates (partialled out, never counted as discoveries) or predictors — the current text claims both roles.
